description: A controller of 1 to 3 drones of one crebain.body world, for example a neural network. It receives the world's observation of its drones and proposes one acceleration for each drone. It has no other access to the world. ENU frame, meters, seconds.

request.drone_ids: 1 to 3 sorted, unique drone identifiers of one world
request.tick_ms: milliseconds of simulated time for each step
request.targets_m: 3 target position components for each drone, in drone order
request.parameters: an object with the controller's own settings; each controller documents its members

result.controller: a description of the controller, for example its model and settings
result.drone_ids: the drone identifiers of the request

request.tick_index: the step that the proposed actions will drive, one more than the observation's tick
request.source_state_digest: the state digest of the world's observation
request.estimate_available: for each drone, whether the world has an estimate of it
request.position_m: 3 components of the estimated position for each drone; zeros where no estimate is available
request.velocity_mps: 3 components of the estimated velocity for each drone; zeros where no estimate is available

result.acceleration_mps2: 3 finite components of the proposed acceleration for each drone; each at most 50 in magnitude and not negative zero, which the world rejects
